name: How long does it take to complete a second story addition?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete a second story addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a second story addition can vary based on project scope, design complexity, and permit processing times. Generally, the design and permitting phase can take 2-4 months, while construction typically spans 6-12 months. Factors such as weather conditions, material availability, and the homeowner's responsiveness to selections can influence the overall duration. A detailed project schedule will be provided after the design is finalized.
acceptedAnswer.description: A second story addition typically takes 6-12 months for construction, following 2-4 months for design and permitting, influenced by project scope and approvals.
